name: Charchika Temple
description: A Shakti temple at Banki, situated on a small hill beside the Mahanadi river and associated with the Charchika tradition.

name: Maa Tarini Temple
query: Maa Tarini Temple, Ghatgaon, Kendujhar, Odisha
description: A busy Shakti temple at Ghatgaon in Kendujhar district, known for the large number of devotees who visit throughout the year.
significance: A major folk Shakti shrine in the tribal-majority highlands of Odisha.

name: Khirachora Gopinatha Temple
query: Khirachora Gopinatha Temple, Remuna, Balasore, Odisha
description: A Vaishnava temple at Remuna, associated with the Gopinatha tradition and the legend of the kheer offering.
significance: A noted Vaishnava pilgrimage site in northern Odisha.

name: Kapilash Temple
description: A hilltop temple dedicated to Chandrasekhar Shiva in the Kapilash hills, approached by a long flight of steps.

name: Kichakeswari Temple
description: A temple at Khiching dedicated to Kichakeswari, in an area known for its early stone sculpture and brick temples.
significance: Important religious and art-historical site of the former Mayurbhanj state.

name: Qadam Rasool Mosque
description: A mosque and shrine in Cuttack said to house a footprint relic associated with the Prophet Muhammad. It is a place of worship and a local heritage site.
significance: A historic Islamic site in Cuttack and an active place of worship.

name: Jama Masjid, Cuttack
description: A congregational mosque in Cuttack serving the city's Muslim community.

name: Baptist Church, Cuttack
description: A Baptist church in Cuttack recorded in OpenStreetMap, serving the city's Christian community.

name: Gurudwara Sri Guru Singh Sabha
description: A Sikh gurdwara in Bhubaneswar, open to visitors as a place of worship and community service.

name: Dhauli Shanti Stupa
destination_type: Buddhist stupa and Ashokan edict site
description: A hilltop peace pagoda built in the 1970s beside the Ashokan rock edicts at Dhauli, overlooking the Daya river plain south of Bhubaneswar.
significance: Associated with the Mauryan emperor Ashoka and his edicts; the modern stupa is a peace monument.

name: Ratnagiri Mahavihara
description: The excavated remains of a major Buddhist monastic centre at Ratnagiri, with stupas, monastery courts and a site museum containing sculpture.
significance: A key site of the ancient Buddhist complex in the Birupa river valley.

name: Lalitgiri Buddhist Complex
description: An excavated Buddhist hilltop site with stupas and monastery remains, part of the cluster of early Buddhist centres near the Birupa valley.
significance: One of the principal Buddhist archaeological sites of Odisha.

name: Udayagiri Buddhist Complex
description: A Buddhist site on a low hill with excavated stupas and monastic structures, sometimes called Udayagiri-2 to distinguish it from the Jain caves near Bhubaneswar.
significance: Part of Odisha's early Buddhist heritage in the Jajpur region.

name: Udayagiri and Khandagiri Caves
query: Udayagiri and Khandagiri Caves, Bhubaneswar, Odisha
description: Twin hills west of Bhubaneswar containing rock-cut caves and shelters carved mainly in the 1st century BCE, several with inscriptions associated with King Kharavela. The site is especially significant in Jain heritage.
significance: A major early Jain rock-cut complex and an ASI-protected monument.

name: Sisupalgarh
description: The remains of an ancient fortified settlement near Bhubaneswar, visible mainly as earthen ramparts and excavated foundations.
significance: An important early historic urban site in coastal Odisha.

name: Barabati Fort
description: The remains of a medieval fort at Cuttack, including a gateway and earthworks beside the Mahanadi, now part of a protected heritage area.
significance: Associated with the Gajapati rulers and later powers that controlled coastal Odisha.

name: Konark Sun Temple
query: Konark Sun Temple, Konark, Puri, Odisha
description: A 13th-century temple conceived as a monumental stone chariot for the Sun God, with extensive sculpture and the surviving audience hall. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
significance: Among the best-known monuments of India and a masterpiece of Kalinga architecture.
